label: Bible Study
prompt: Blessed is he that _____, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verse: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
note: Revelation opens with a blessing on whoever reads it aloud and whoever listens.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be _____, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
verse: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
note: A word for fearful hearts: be strong, fear not — your God will come and save you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would _____ him of his leprosy.
verse: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
note: A captive Israelite servant girl pointed her master Naaman to the prophet who could heal his leprosy.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are _____ already to harvest.
verse: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
note: Samaritan townspeople were already heading toward Jesus as he spoke — the 'harvest' was walking up the road.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto _____ much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verse: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
note: The stewardship principle in a sentence: 'unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required.'
